notes.title: Pixel Puzzles: February Newsletter
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/dKBeXZB.png[/IMG]
[b] Welcome to the first in our monthly newsletters. These newsletters are  designed to keep you informed as to whats happening in the amazing world of digital jigsaw puzzles. [/b] 

[h1] Pixel Puzzles website is finally ready [/h1] 
The new site contains information on all things Pixel Puzzles. You can find upcoming pack info, checkout the current challenge, check out our social pages and more.
[url=http://pixelpuzzles.co.uk/] Website[/url] 

[h1] Pixel Puzzles now has a Facebook page [/h1] 
The Pixel Puzzles Facebook page is now live. Like the page and get even more news and updates.
[url=https://www.facebook.com/PixelPuzzles] Facebook[/url] 

[h1] New 'Unique' area [/h1] 
This month we will be rolling out the new ‘Uniques’ area for Pixel Puzzles Ultimate. This is where you will be able to spend some of your Golden Pieces on unique figural puzzles. You can also use your Ultimate Pieces that you’ve earned from completing challenges, on special experimental puzzles, including a mega 1410 piece puzzle.

[h1] Even more puzzles available for Pixel Puzzles Ultimate [/h1] 
All of the previous Pixel Puzzles titles (minus RADical ROACH) can now be played within Pixel Puzzles Ultimate. If you own any of the previous Pixel Puzzles titles, you will automatically receive the corresponding puzzle pack DLC for Ultimate for FREE. The final Pixel Puzzles 2 series title Pixel Puzzles 2 RADical ROACH pack for Pixel Puzzles Ultimate will be released later this month.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/8euLyIW.png[/IMG]

[h1] New Pixel Puzzle Ultimate Pack Releases: [/h1] 
[list]
    [*]FEB 3TH - Australia  
    [*]FEB 3TH - Pin-Ups
    [*]FEB 14TH - Wild West
    [*]FEB 14TH - Landscapes XL
    [*]FEB 21ST - Volcanoes
    [*]FEB 21ST – Chernobyl
[/list] 
[h1] Pixel Puzzles Ultimate: Challenge Puzzle 3[/h1] 
February 1st - March 1st

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/6XbJHX3.png[/IMG]

[h1]Subscribe to the newsletter here![/h1] 
[url=http://pixelpuzzles.co.uk/] PixelPuzzles[/url]

Enjoy!!!

notes.title: PATCH - 22/FEB/2016 - Version: 1.0.2.38
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/hwPX3fz.jpg[/IMG]

Version: 1.0.2.38 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This is just another quick little patch addressing a few requests to have an option to turn off puzzle piece rotation and having achievements retroactively activate if the puzzle was completed before the previous patch's achievement fix.

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    [*]Option to turn off piece rotation in options menu.
    [*]Fixed options menu active option highlights not showing.
    [*]Achievements will now retroactively activate in the puzzle select menu if a puzzle was completed before the previous 1.0.1.37 patched version.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!
